facts.fact: Nielsen's The Gauge launched in 2021 and has been published monthly since.

facts.fact: Nielsen's Gauge measures total minutes viewed rather than unique viewers, so a service with fewer viewers who watch longer can rank higher.

facts.fact: Nielsen's The Gauge generally excludes mobile and desktop viewing and covers TV screens only.
facts.quote: **TV screens only.** The Gauge generally excludes mobile and desktop viewing.

facts.fact: Nielsen is rolling out a new DASH measurement approach, but paused full implementation, and January and February 2026 figures use pre-DASH methodology.
